messages.content:
## Hey team, 

I’m raising this ticket to officially log my findings and take ownership of the custom extension and PoC video I created. 

**Just to keep it brief:**
- I found **20 security vulnerabilities** in the ViBe platform (hardcoded credentials, API bypasses, etc.).
- I built a custom Chrome extension called **"Vibe Check"** to safely test these on the client side, making sure I didn't mess with your server logs.
- I recorded a 5-minute unlisted PoC video to demonstrate everything. I saw it already has over **1.5 hours of watch time**, so I’m guessing the dev team is already watching it thoroughly and working on the fixes!

**Here is the link to the unlisted video:** 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2P60CnrJ6oc
*I have also attached the report, please do check it.*

**I mainly just wanted to follow up on two things:**
1. **Any updates on the patches?** I’m totally down to hop on a call and help the dev team reproduce or fix anything if needed.
2. **Please forward this report directly to Sudarshan sir.** He’s the main reason I joined this internship, and getting his feedback on my security assessment would mean a lot to me.

Let me know what the next steps are. Thanks!
